# TASK 6 — MACHINE LEARNING MODEL DEPLOYMENT

This document loads the four artifacts produced by Tasks 1–5 and generates a complete, self-contained **Shiny dashboard** (`app.R`). The dashboard satisfies every requirement of the brief:

- ✅ Loads the trained GBM into a deployment environment (`readRDS("final_model_gbm.rds")`).
- ✅ User-friendly, 6-tab interface built with `bslib`.
- ✅ Real-time predictions from user-entered predictor values.
- ✅ Displays **probability (%)**, **risk band** (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH), and a **recommended action**.
- ✅ Integrates **Explainable AI** — SHAP + Break Down for individual predictions, plus a global feature-importance chart.
- ✅ **Upload the original `credit.csv`** — the app cleans the file, computes the three engineered flags, scores every transaction, and — if `is_fraud` is present — reports accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC, and a confusion matrix.
- ✅ A one-line **launch** command and a one-line **deploy** command (Posit Cloud **or** shinyapps.io).

## 6.2 Generate `app.R`

The next chunk writes the complete Shiny app to `app.R` in the current directory.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
app_code <- r"---(
# ============================================================
# Task 6 — Online Payments Fraud Detection & XAI Dashboard
# Author: MAKINI CALEB
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny);     library(bslib);     library(tidyverse)
  library(plotly);    library(DT);        library(pROC)
  library(yardstick); library(DALEX);     library(caret)
  library(scales)
})

## ---- 1. Load artifacts -------------------------------------------------
required <- c("credit_clean.csv","final_model_gbm.rds",
              "test_set.rds","model_comparison.rds")
missing  <- required[!file.exists(required)]
if (length(missing))
  stop("Missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), " in ", getwd())

data_clean <- read.csv("credit_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(is_fraud            = factor(is_fraud,            levels = c("legit","fraud")),
         foreign_transaction = factor(foreign_transaction, levels = c("no","yes")),
         location_mismatch   = factor(location_mismatch,   levels = c("no","yes")))
final_model <- readRDS("final_model_gbm.rds")
test_set    <- readRDS("test_set.rds")
comparison  <- readRDS("model_comparison.rds")

## ---- 2. Precompute -----------------------------------------------------
pred_fun   <- function(m, newdata) predict(m, newdata = newdata,
                                           type = "prob")[, "fraud"]
test_probs <- pred_fun(final_model, test_set)
y_test     <- as.integer(test_set$is_fraud == "fraud")
x_test     <- test_set |> select(-is_fraud)

explainer  <- DALEX::explain(final_model, data = x_test, y = y_test,
                             predict_function = pred_fun,
                             label = "Gradient Boosting",
                             type = "classification", verbose = FALSE)

PAL <- c(fraud = "#B22222", legit = "#4682B4")
CAT_LEVELS <- levels(x_test$merchant_category)
CAT_LEVELS

## ---- 3. Universal CSV preprocessor -------------------------------------
# Accepts BOTH the raw credit.csv (10 cols, includes is_fraud) and any
# already-cleaned file without the label. Returns scored data + labels.
prep_and_score <- function(df) {
  # Drop the ID column if present
  if ("transaction_id" %in% names(df)) df$transaction_id <- NULL

  # Pull labels aside if present
  actual <- NULL
  if ("is_fraud" %in% names(df)) {
    raw <- df$is_fraud
    actual <- if (is.numeric(raw)) {
      factor(ifelse(raw == 1, "fraud", "legit"), levels = c("legit","fraud"))
    } else {
      factor(as.character(raw), levels = c("legit","fraud"))
    }
    df$is_fraud <- NULL
  }

  # Coerce 0/1 columns to yes/no factor
  coerce_binary <- function(v) {
    if (is.numeric(v)) {
      factor(ifelse(v == 1, "yes", "no"), levels = c("no","yes"))
    } else {
      factor(as.character(v), levels = c("no","yes"))
    }
  }
  if ("foreign_transaction" %in% names(df))
    df$foreign_transaction <- coerce_binary(df$foreign_transaction)
  if ("location_mismatch" %in% names(df))
    df$location_mismatch   <- coerce_binary(df$location_mismatch)

  # Merchant category — align to training levels; unknowns become NA
  if ("merchant_category" %in% names(df))
    df$merchant_category <- factor(as.character(df$merchant_category),
                                   levels = CAT_LEVELS)

  # Engineered features (must match Task 1.4 exactly)
  df$impossible   <- df$amount <= 0
  df$micro_amount <- df$amount > 0 & df$amount < 0.10
  df$high_value   <- df$amount > 1200

  # Rows we can score (drop impossible — matches Task 1.5 cleaning)
  scoreable <- df[df$amount > 0 & !is.na(df$merchant_category), , drop = FALSE]
  n_dropped <- nrow(df) - nrow(scoreable)

  # Score
  probs <- pred_fun(final_model, scoreable[, names(x_test), drop = FALSE])
  scoreable$p_fraud  <- as.numeric(probs)
  scoreable$risk_band <- cut(scoreable$p_fraud,
                             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.30, 0.55, Inf),
                             labels = c("LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH"))
  scoreable$recommended_action <- ifelse(scoreable$p_fraud < 0.30, "Auto-approve",
                                  ifelse(scoreable$p_fraud < 0.55,
                                         "Soft challenge / 2FA",
                                         "Block & investigate"))

  # Attach labels back if aligned
  if (!is.null(actual)) {
    scoreable$actual <- actual[df$amount > 0 & !is.na(df$merchant_category)]
  }

  list(df = scoreable, n_dropped = n_dropped, has_labels = !is.null(actual))
}

## ---- 4. Single-row predictor (Predict tab) -----------------------------
predict_one <- function(amount, hour, cat, foreign, mismatch,
                        trust, velocity, age) {
  nd <- tibble(
    amount             = amount,
    transaction_hour   = hour,
    merchant_category  = factor(cat, levels = CAT_LEVELS),
    foreign_transaction= factor(foreign, levels = c("no","yes")),
    location_mismatch  = factor(mismatch, levels = c("no","yes")),
    device_trust_score = trust,
    velocity_last_24h  = velocity,
    cardholder_age     = age,
    impossible         = amount <= 0,
    micro_amount       = amount > 0 & amount < 0.10,
    high_value         = amount > 1200)
  list(prob = as.numeric(pred_fun(final_model, nd)), row = nd)
}

## ---- 6. Server ---------------------------------------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  ## === Overview ===
  output$ov_class <- renderPlotly({
    d <- data_clean |> count(is_fraud)
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(is_fraud, n, fill = is_fraud)) +
      geom_col(width = .55, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)), vjust = -.4, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = PAL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Transactions") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  output$ov_cat <- renderPlotly({
    d <- data_clean |> group_by(merchant_category) |>
      summarise(rate = mean(is_fraud=="fraud"), .groups = "drop")
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(reorder(merchant_category, rate), rate, fill = rate)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = percent(rate,.1)), hjust = -.15, size = 3.2) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#A9C4E0", high = PAL[["fraud"]]) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(.1),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.2))) +
      coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraud rate") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplotly(p)
  })

  ## === Predict ===
  pred_result <- eventReactive(input$go, {
    predict_one(input$amt, input$hr, input$cat, input$frn, input$mis,
                input$trs, input$vel, input$age)
  })
  output$prob_txt <- renderText({
    req(pred_result()); sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * pred_result()$prob) })
  output$risk_txt <- renderText({
    req(pred_result()); p <- pred_result()$prob
    if (p < .30) "LOW" else if (p < .55) "MEDIUM" else "HIGH" })
  output$act_txt <- renderText({
    req(pred_result()); p <- pred_result()$prob
    if (p < .30) "Auto-approve"
    else if (p < .55) "Soft challenge / 2FA"
    else "Block & investigate" })
  output$gauge <- renderPlotly({
    req(pred_result())
    plot_ly(type = "indicator", mode = "gauge+number",
            value = round(100 * pred_result()$prob, 1),
            number = list(suffix = "%"), title = list(text = "P(fraud)"),
            gauge = list(axis = list(range = list(0,100)),
                         bar  = list(color = PAL[["fraud"]]),
                         steps = list(list(range = c(0,30),  color="#D4EDDA"),
                                      list(range = c(30,55), color="#FFF3CD"),
                                      list(range = c(55,100),color="#F8D7DA")))) |>
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })
  output$pred_shap <- renderPlot({
    req(pred_result())
    withProgress(message = "SHAP…", value = .4,
      p <- DALEX::predict_parts(explainer,
                                new_observation = pred_result()$row,
                                type = "shap", B = 15))
    plot(p) + labs(title = "Why? Top SHAP contributions")
  })

  ## === Upload CSV ===
  upload_result <- reactive({
    req(input$upload)
    df <- read.csv(input$upload$datapath, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    prep_and_score(df)
  })

  output$upload_status <- renderUI({
    req(upload_result())
    r <- upload_result()
    cls <- if (nrow(r$df) > 0) "alert-info" else "alert-warning"
    extra <- if (r$n_dropped > 0)
      paste0(" ", r$n_dropped, " row(s) removed (amount \u2264 0 or unknown category).")
    tags$div(class = paste("alert", cls),
             if (nrow(r$df) > 0)
               paste0("Scored ", nrow(r$df), " rows.", extra)
             else "No valid rows after cleaning.")
  })
  output$n_scored <- renderText({ req(upload_result()); nrow(upload_result()$df) })
  output$n_high   <- renderText({ req(upload_result()); sum(upload_result()$df$risk_band == "HIGH") })
  output$n_med    <- renderText({ req(upload_result()); sum(upload_result()$df$risk_band == "MEDIUM") })
  output$n_low    <- renderText({ req(upload_result()); sum(upload_result()$df$risk_band == "LOW") })

  output$has_labels <- reactive({ req(upload_result()); upload_result()$has_labels })
  outputOptions(output, "has_labels", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

  upload_metrics <- reactive({
    req(upload_result())
    r <- upload_result()
    if (!r$has_labels) return(NULL)
    df <- r$df
    pred <- factor(ifelse(df$p_fraud >= .55, "fraud", "legit"),
                   levels = c("legit","fraud"))
    cm   <- caret::confusionMatrix(pred, df$actual, positive = "fraud")
    auc  <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(df$actual, df$p_fraud, quiet = TRUE,
                                            levels = c("legit","fraud"), direction = "<")))
    list(cm = cm, auc = auc)
  })
  output$up_acc  <- renderText({ m <- upload_metrics(); if (is.null(m)) "—"
                                 sprintf("%.3f", m$cm$overall["Accuracy"]) })
  output$up_prec <- renderText({ m <- upload_metrics(); if (is.null(m)) "—"
                                 sprintf("%.3f", m$cm$byClass["Precision"]) })
  output$up_rec  <- renderText({ m <- upload_metrics(); if (is.null(m)) "—"
                                 sprintf("%.3f", m$cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) })
  output$up_f1   <- renderText({ m <- upload_metrics(); if (is.null(m)) "—"
                                 sprintf("%.3f", m$cm$byClass["F1"]) })

  output$up_cm <- renderDT({
    m <- upload_metrics(); req(m)
    tab <- as.data.frame.matrix(m$cm$table)
    tab <- cbind(Predicted = rownames(tab), tab)
    datatable(tab, rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 5)) |>
      formatStyle(columns = 2:3, fontWeight = "bold")
  })

  output$up_tbl <- renderDT({
    req(upload_result())
    df <- upload_result()$df
    show_cols <- c("amount","merchant_category","p_fraud","risk_band",
                   "recommended_action", if (upload_result()$has_labels) "actual")
    df |> arrange(desc(p_fraud)) |>
      select(all_of(show_cols)) |>
      datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
      formatRound("p_fraud", 4) |>
      formatCurrency("amount", currency = "$", digits = 2) |>
      formatStyle("risk_band",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH"),
                                     c("#D4EDDA","#FFF3CD","#F8D7DA")))
  })

  output$dl_scored <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0("scored_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
    content  = function(f) write.csv(upload_result()$df, f, row.names = FALSE))

  ## === Explain XAI ===
  top_idx <- order(test_probs, decreasing = TRUE)[1:25]
  updateSelectInput(session, "row_pick",
    choices = setNames(top_idx,
      paste0("Row ", top_idx, " — P=", round(test_probs[top_idx], 3),
             ifelse(y_test[top_idx]==1, " [fraud]", " [legit]"))),
    selected = top_idx[1])

  output$row_details <- renderTable({
    idx <- as.integer(input$row_pick)
    tibble(Field = c("Row","P(fraud)","Actual","Amount","Hour","Velocity",
                     "Trust","Category","Foreign","Mismatch"),
           Value = c(idx, round(test_probs[idx], 3),
                     as.character(test_set$is_fraud[idx]),
                     dollar(test_set$amount[idx]),
                     test_set$transaction_hour[idx],
                     test_set$velocity_last_24h[idx],
                     test_set$device_trust_score[idx],
                     as.character(test_set$merchant_category[idx]),
                     as.character(test_set$foreign_transaction[idx]),
                     as.character(test_set$location_mismatch[idx])))
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  shap_res <- eventReactive(input$go_xai, {
    idx <- as.integer(input$row_pick)
    withProgress(message = "SHAP…", value = .4,
      DALEX::predict_parts(explainer,
                           new_observation = x_test[idx, , drop=FALSE],
                           type = "shap", B = 15))
  })
  output$shap_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(shap_res()); plot(shap_res()) +
      labs(title = sprintf("Row %s — P=%.3f", input$row_pick,
                           test_probs[as.integer(input$row_pick)]))
  })

  bd_res <- eventReactive(input$go_xai, {
    idx <- as.integer(input$row_pick)
    DALEX::predict_parts(explainer,
                         new_observation = x_test[idx, , drop=FALSE],
                         type = "break_down")
  })
  output$bd_plot <- renderPlot({ req(bd_res()); plot(bd_res()) })

  ## === Models ===
  output$tbl_models <- renderDT({
    datatable(comparison, rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 10)) |>
      formatStyle("PR_AUC",
        background = styleColorBar(comparison$PR_AUC, "#B22222"),
        backgroundSize = "100% 90%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
        backgroundPosition = "center")
  })
  output$bar_models <- renderPlotly({
    p <- ggplot(comparison, aes(reorder(Model, PR_AUC), PR_AUC, fill = Model)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", PR_AUC)), hjust = -.15, size = 3.2) +
      coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.15))) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "PR-AUC") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  output$roc_plot <- renderPlotly({
    r <- pROC::roc(test_set$is_fraud, test_probs, quiet = TRUE,
                   levels = c("legit","fraud"), direction = "<")
    df <- tibble(fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities) |> arrange(fpr)
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
      geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
      geom_path(colour = PAL[["fraud"]], linewidth = 1.1) + coord_equal() +
      labs(x = "FPR", y = "TPR",
           title = sprintf("AUC = %.3f", as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)))) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  output$pr_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- yardstick::pr_curve(tibble(truth = test_set$is_fraud, prob = test_probs),
                              truth, prob, event_level = "second")
    pauc <- yardstick::pr_auc_vec(test_set$is_fraud, test_probs, event_level = "second")
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(recall, precision)) +
      geom_path(colour = PAL[["fraud"]], linewidth = 1.1) +
      labs(x = "Recall", y = "Precision",
           title = sprintf("PR-AUC = %.3f", pauc)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
)---"

writeLines(app_code, "app.R")
cat("Wrote app.R to", getwd(), "\n")
```

## 6.6 Brief guide — how to use the deployed app

| Tab | What to do | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| **Overview** | (read) | KPI cards, class-imbalance chart, per-category fraud rate |
| **Predict** | Fill 8 fields → **Score transaction** | **P(fraud) %**, **risk band** (LOW < 30% / MEDIUM 30–55% / HIGH ≥ 55%), **recommended action**, gauge, and a **SHAP** bar chart showing *why* this transaction scored that way |
| **Upload CSV** | Drop the **original `credit.csv`** (or any file with the same predictors) into the uploader | Row count, counts by risk band, and — if `is_fraud` is present — **accuracy / precision / recall / F1** plus a **confusion matrix**. Data table is sortable; **Download scored CSV** gives you the full scored file |
| **Explain XAI** | Pick any of the top-25 highest-scoring test rows → **Explain** | Row details, **SHAP** waterfall, **Break Down** narrative — side by side |
| **Models** | (read) | Leaderboard, PR-AUC bars, ROC and PR curves |
| **About** | (read) | Method recap |

**Typical analyst flow.**

1. *Live transaction* → **Predict**.
2. *Case review* → **Explain XAI** (produces the audit trail).
3. *End-of-day sweep* → **Upload CSV** with the original `credit.csv` → read the confusion matrix → download the scored file.
4. *Threshold tuning* → **Models**.

## 6.7 Optional — AI assistant

If you want to satisfy the "optional AI assistant" line in the brief, drop this into the **About** tab and set the `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable before deploying:

```r
# In the About tab — add near the other cards:
card(card_header("Ask the AI about this prediction"),
     textInput("ai_q", NULL,
               placeholder = "e.g. Why is this transaction risky?"),
     actionButton("ai_go", "Ask", class = "btn-info"),
     verbatimTextOutput("ai_ans"))

# In the server:
observeEvent(input$ai_go, {
  req(pred_result(), nzchar(Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")))
  res <- httr::POST(
    "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
    httr::add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))),
    httr::content_type_json(),
    body = jsonlite::toJSON(list(
      model    = "gpt-4o-mini",
      messages = list(list(
        role    = "user",
        content = sprintf(
          "A fraud model scored this transaction at P=%.3f. Context: %s. User asks: %s. Answer in 2 sentences.",
          pred_result()$prob,
          jsonlite::toJSON(pred_result()$row, auto_unbox = TRUE),
          input$ai_q)))), auto_unbox = TRUE),
    encode = "raw")
  output$ai_ans <- renderText(
    httr::content(res)$choices[[1]]$message$content)
})
```

Set the key once (`Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-...")` in your session) and re-deploy with `forceUpdate = TRUE`.
